readMe.a: Contact Field Health & Tech Debt Analysis — XBU

readMe.b: Identify which Contact fields are genuinely in use and which are tech debt, using measured record-level population rather than estimates.
Live Salesforce metadata (describe + Tooling API) read directly from XBU production (rainprod / Rain) on 2026-11-10.
Not required. Required? / Help Text / Description come from the same live describe + Tooling read.

Live SOQL aggregates against XBU production. All measures are exact counts over every Contact, not a sampled export, except the 14 Long Text Area fields which are sampled (200 records, last 365 days).
228 of 233 live Contact fields assessed. 4 field(s) excluded (not queryable via SOQL — platform-internal or orphaned metadata). 14 Long Text Area fields are listed on Not Assessable.
Flow/Layout/formula/other reference counts come from a fresh MetadataComponentDependency crawl of all 182 custom fields on 2026-11-10 (not carried forward from a prior snapshot).
Weights, thresholds and bands are carried over unchanged from the shared Case/Opportunity model so every object and business unit scores on the same scale.
